hypothesis: Transfer the Modern GAN paper's Stacked MNIST training recipe to Forge's fixed toy hosts, distinguishing the complete scheduled Adam/R1/R2 recipe from the prior penalty-only swap.
changed_factors: plain torch Adam with beta1=0, beta2 cosine 0.9 to 0.99 over the first 20% of each frozen host horizon
R1+R2 gamma cosine 1 to 0.1 over the same burn-in; penalty every discriminator update
constant network and learned-prior LR 0.0002 with equal role multipliers and eps=1e-8
disable K3P input/output noise, A2 damping, critic guard/anchor and direct-particle gain
mechanism_rationale: A substantive public optimizer and schedule change, not a seed experiment or coefficient sweep. Transfer Appendix D Table 19 Stacked MNIST training settings using completed host updates in place of processed images; 2/10 Mimg becomes 20% of the frozen host horizon. Existing toy architectures, auxiliary objectives, initialization, prior, budgets and clean/live sampling gates remain task-owned. The paper's image architecture, fixed Gaussian latent prior, 10M-image training budget and EMA image evaluation are not reproduced.
api_changes: Public Recipe optimizer_family, eps and cosine beta2/reg_coeff endpoints; shared factories and caller-owned update schedules honor the same settings across Forge hosts. Defaults preserve existing recipes.
